mission.Xiomara_Corp_RaiderCapture1.brie: Even if analysts of %VICTIM_NAME% are expecting an attack from <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>, the appearance of a trained operator <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> here will be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, but remember that great causes require great cruelty.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_RaiderCapture1.deta:
Details: Feathered Masks are looking for anyone who will help them capture %STATION_NAME% in order to turn this place into another bastion of fight against Tezctlan.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this piece of metal as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let's crush them, and Xiomara will be pleased with the fulfillment of the contract.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Ritual1.after: Good job. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> will be able to operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. The quasimorphs have already transferred the reward to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Ritual1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> cannot wait, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. Your task is to make your way to the ritual site and <color=#FFFEC1>hold your position</color> until the end. You have to hold out.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Ritual1.details:
Details: One of the reasons why Tezctlan tried to eliminate Xiomara is the knowledge that allows her and Feathered Masks maintain contact with physical reality. She stole the secret from the King of Gannix after his return from Earth. To maintain existence in the physical world, an influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets are necessary.

Xiomara senses that on %STATION_NAME% the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

Feathered Masks call on all available forces to ensure the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Ritual1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Sabotage1.after: %STATION_NAME% is now completely blinded and stunned. We have created great difficulties for %VICTIM_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> are satisfied with our work. They are planning to take over this station in the near future. The reward is already on Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Sabotage1.briefing: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>transmitters</color>, but you will have to cover part of the distance on foot. It will not be easy: according to sensor data, the security forces of %VICTIM_NAME% are ready to engage. The good news is that the communication network nodes are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Show them what war is. Remind them who paved the way to freedom for the corporations.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Sabotage1.details:
Details: Xiomara is preparing to lead the Order of Feathered Masks into battle against Tezctlan. We must honor our part of the contract and serve her whenever possible.

One of her dukes has conveyed a message regarding Xiomara’s interest in %STATION_NAME%. Located here is a device capable of intercepting “mysterious voices from space.” Xiomara wants it destroyed before she sends her servants to seize the station.

Our analysts have examined this asset of %VICTIM_NAME%. It appears to be an ordinary communications system. If we reach the transmitters and destroy them, Xiomara will be satisfied. For a while.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Sabotage1.objective: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the transmitters</color>. A transmitter is a satellite dish aimed into space. A marker is present on your map.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Defense1.briefin: Fighters from %VICTIM_NAME% have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold your defense</color> until the enemies retreat.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Defense1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is evidence that the appearance of the Solar System has changed forever. But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Elimination1.aft:
Xiomara is pleased with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

Feathered Masks gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Elimination1.bri: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %VICTIM_NAME% is using countermeasures on %STATION_NAME%, so we have to maneuver. Sensors show that personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Make a massacre, but <color=#FFFEC1>eliminate the target</color>. Let's make <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> happy!
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Elimination1.det:
Details: Feathered Masks are gradually joining the fight for the Solar System. They perceive people as allies or a source of gavvakh. And it would be better for us to be the first.

Now Xiomara is interested in %STATION_NAME%, which is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. Feathered Masks believe that there is a factor preventing the capture of this place. They talk about "a great warrior defending a place of power." Our analysts studied the station and came to the conclusion that we are talking about the commander of the station’s defense.

Xiomara will be extremely pleased if we kill this warrior.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific <color=#FFFEC1>task</color>: to escort the Duke to safety at %STATION_NAME%. You should easily deal with the militants of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the object is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location at the station and protect it from attacks by the rabble of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Escort1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Infiltration1.af: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Infiltration1.br:
Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. The quasimorphs are ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Infiltration1.de:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can get here before the attackers and eliminate the infiltration teams of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the future owners of the Solar System will be extremely generous.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.a: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> is pleased with our work. %STATION_NAME% now resembles Pandemonium. A gift from her appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. It's worth testing this artifact in action.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.b: Even if the personnel of %STATION_NAME% are expecting an attack by <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>, the appearance of a trained operator <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> here will be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, be careful.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_RaiderCapture1.d:
Details: Xiomara has seriously taken up the task of establishing order in the Solar System. Now she is looking for anyone who will help the Feather Masks capture %STATION_NAME% to continue the fight against Tezctlan.

%VICTIM_NAME% holding on to this metal piece of material as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let's crush them, and Xiomara will have a task worthy of our talents.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Ritual1.after: Good job, <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> extremely pleased. The ritual was completed successfully. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> will be able to operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. They transferred the reward to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Ritual1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> cannot wait, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. Make your way to the ritual site and <color=#FFFEC1>hold your position</color> until it is completed. Let's make <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> happy!
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Ritual1.details:
Details: Xiomara has mastered the secret that allows her and Feathered Masks to maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires constant effort. An influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets are needed.

The Lady senses that on %STATION_NAME% the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

Xiomara calls on all available forces to ensure that the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Ritual1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Sabotage1.after:
Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. Somehow, the quasimorphs gradually become aware of the sensitive infrastructure of humans.

Xiomara is incredibly satisfied with our work. She transferred something special from her arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Sabotage1.briefi: We will try to drop you as close as possible to the nearest <color=#FFFEC1>computer</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Let us do this job for the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>, and the Lady will turn her gaze toward us.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Sabotage1.detail:
Details: Feathered Masks are gradually joining the fight for the Solar System. We have more and more opportunities to serve the Mistress. She shows interest in %STATION_NAME%.

%VICTIM_NAME% placed there what the quasimorphs called an Altar of Knowledge. The Feathered Masks need this device destroyed before they go to capture %STATION_NAME%. Apparently, we are talking about some kind of computer, which %VICTIM_NAME% uses for an unknown purpose. If we destroy it, Xiomara will be favorable to us.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Security1.briefi: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Xiomara herself will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Security1.detail:
Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy meeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Xiomara_Pirates_Security1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the pirate squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Control1.briefing: %VICTIM_NAME% is already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% has long been waging war against its quasimorphic enemies and is ready to attack %STATION_NAME%. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Control1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? And is it worth doing this for the sake of other quasimorphs?
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that hostile quasimorphs have already appeared in certain areas of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% needs our services. Their %STATION_NAME% is being attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%. Both groups of quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but have also learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. Each faction considers itself the true master of the Solar System.

An attack on the station can begin at any moment, and if we want to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Elimination1.after: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> is pleased with the result of our work. A gift for our obedience awaits in the Magnum's cargo hold.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Elimination1.brief: We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%. Don't take unnecessary risks, save your strength. I send the target location to your map. Good luck.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Elimination1.detai: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Quasimorphs have captured %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> wants her enemies to be taught a lesson. <color=#FFFEC1>The Duke</color> of %VICTIM_NAME% is currently located in this location. They prepare quasimorphs to attack the bases of the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>. Their <color=#FFFEC1>elimination</color> is a good way to please <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke</color> to safety at %STATION_NAME%. Quasimorphs will send the best warriors into battle, so be careful.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing to attack %STATION_NAME%. However, it has been turned into a real fortress by %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems it is planning to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The Quasimorphs call on their loyal servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard.

We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Escort1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Espionage1.after: The meeting with the warriors of <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> took place. We gave them the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>, they gave us a gift from <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Espionage1.briefin:
The signature of igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Espionage1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. Xiomara senses the presence of an extremely important thing there, which will help her in the fight for the Solar System.

The Warriors of the Feathered Masks told us that there is an igvalite on %STATION_NAME% - a mineral-like entity. It is able to accumulate gavvakh - energy that powers quasimorphs. If we want to serve Xiomara, we must get her this igvalite.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Espionage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Infiltration1.afte: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Infiltration1.brie:
Several groups of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

How did we even get into this, Boss?
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Infiltration1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Infiltration1.deta:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has held %STATION_NAME% for a long time. However, it is now under attack from %VICTIM_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an Igvalite coming from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can eliminate the groups of quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% who have come for the igvalite. Let's do this, and the reward from the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely high.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Infiltration1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.aft: Servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> are settling in at %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> are pleased with our success. They transferred something extremely valuable to Magnum.
